bull.b: Elfabrio is showing commercial traction while gaining geographic and dosing approvals that can broaden patient access. Expansion through Chiesi and improved dosing convenience support stronger product adoption and a more durable revenue base over the coming quarters.

The cash position and absence of debt provide financial flexibility to fund operations, manufacturing and pipeline development without immediate reliance on external financing. This strengthens resilience and gives Protalix greater capacity to pursue growth through clinical and commercial milestones.

A proprietary expression platform gives Protalix an established technological foundation for developing and manufacturing recombinant therapies. Its use across commercial and pipeline programs can support internal capabilities, recurring supply economics and future partnering opportunities.

bear.b: Dependence on Chiesi and uneven purchasing can make reported revenue difficult to forecast from quarter to quarter. This variability may obscure underlying product demand, complicate planning and reduce the visibility of recurring commercial cash generation over the next several quarters.

The milestone materially boosted first-half revenue but is not expected to recur in the same way. Comparisons could weaken when this contribution rolls off, making ongoing performance more dependent on repeat Elfabrio sales and exposing the business to uneven partnership economics.

The observed anti-drug antibody rate and unresolved dosing choice create meaningful uncertainty for PRX-115 development. Immunogenicity and infusion-related reactions could require regimen changes, affect timelines and reduce the program’s eventual commercial positioning or probability of success.
